name: Well Stone
summary: Across Mulgore, Well Stones rest beside the water wells. Their earth and water magic helps prepare the Water of the Seers for tauren rites of passage.

sections.title: Vessel of Earthen Energies
sections.body: Well Stones rest in the soft earth beside Mulgore’s wells, where they absorb the spiritual resonance of the plains and the waters beneath them. Shaman and seers such as Zarlman Two-Moons know these stones as vessels of vital magic, not ordinary river pebbles. Combined with grounded Ambercorn beneath the plains’ mighty trees, their mineral properties temper the brew that awakens visionary trances in young tauren during the sacred Rite of Vision.

faq.q: What are Well Stones used for?
faq.answer: Well Stones are combined with Ambercorn to brew the Water of the Seers. Initiates drink it before the tribal fire, and it grants a guiding vision to those seeking to prove their spiritual maturity.
Well Stones lie on the ground around the communal water wells scattered across Mulgore, where the plains’ life-giving moisture meets the soil.
Zarlman Two-Moons, a respected mystic in Bloodhoof Village, directs initiates to gather Well Stones as part of the Rite of Vision.

angles.text: For young tauren, gathering Well Stones is an essential step in showing communion with the land. It teaches how the earth’s physical elements contribute to spiritual enlightenment.
Shaman know Well Stones as natural anchors of earth and water magic. Their latent spirits come together in a transformative ceremonial mixture.
